sketches.mechanism: A top-level recursive binding can be assigned a fully polymorphic type; it typechecks as any value, but evaluating it diverges.
sketches.resonance: It can promise to become anything only by never arriving.

sketches.mechanism: Negation as failure: \+ Goal succeeds when Goal cannot be proven, so an absence of proof becomes an operative fact.
sketches.resonance: What cannot be shown to be here is accepted as gone.

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroes weak references when the last strong owner leaves scope, and weak references must therefore be optional.
sketches.resonance: What is held only weakly is allowed by the language to vanish.
